name: pilot_report

steps: add scripts/pilot_report.py: read each run through evals.runlog, decide known cost with evals.score.cost_is_known
print the per-run rows and the aggregate exactly as the issue defines them; refuse bad arguments with exit 2
risks: an unknown cost or a missing minute must never be counted as 0
the key order, the rounding and the nano-dollar sum are part of the output

unverifiable: that the script reads runs only through evals.runlog and decides known cost only with cost_is_known (the tests see the output, not the code path)
that nothing else was changed: the scope protects the rest, but a reviewer must read the diff
readability and the internal layout of scripts/pilot_report.py
